svg.title: Foundry Toolbox: tools and skills
svg.desc: The local or Foundry-hosted Field Ops agent uses one authenticated MCP session with preview headers. tools/list and tools/call provide tool_search discovery and call_tool invocation for Inventory MCP, Work Orders OpenAPI, and FoundryIQ KB MCP. resources/list and resources/read expose skill://index.json, skill descriptions, URLs, and SKILL.md instructions. McpSkillsSource converts instructions to InlineSkill objects for SkillsProvider and load_skill activity. Browser automation is not registered by the publisher and requires additional Toolbox configuration.

g.text: One authenticated MCP session exposes two distinct surfaces

Browser automation for the separate status dashboard requires additional Toolbox configuration.
Official Azure service icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center (V24).
